budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair said the Select Board voted on November 8, 2022 to effectively lower the tax rate from the prior year's rate to the new rate for FY2023.
budget_items.quote: the select board voted to effectively decrease the tax rate from $17.19 to $14.62 cents per one thousand dollars of value

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average single-family home was valued at $470,164 and the average single-family tax bill is stated as $6,873.80 per year, about $438 more than the prior fiscal year.
budget_items.quote: is $6,873.80 per year and is approximately $438 per household more than the last fiscal year.

budget_items.topic: Valuation and tax increases over five years
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair said the average single-family home's value rose 52% over five years and its property tax rose about 19% over the same period; residents reported increases of 30%, 50%, and more.
budget_items.quote: the average single family home has realized a 52% increase in value over the past five

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident said $116,000 had been set aside by the Assessors for possible abatements and argued it was insufficient for about 500 affected houses.
budget_items.quote: $116,000 was set aside, so if all 500 people got relief

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident calculated that the $116,000 set-aside would come to about $230 per household if spread across 500 houses.
budget_items.quote: there are probably other places in town where people deserve abatements other than these people, everybody gets $230.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident said his last quarterly bill paid was $1500 and the current quarter's bill was over $3200.
budget_items.quote: his last quarterly bill paid was $1500, the bill received for this quarter was over $3200.00

budget_items.topic: Quarterly taxes on a 1400 sq ft home
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident said quarterly taxes rose from $1800 to $3900.
budget_items.quote: my taxes went from $1800 to $3900 quarterly.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident said her lake association charges voluntary dues and fundraises for weed control and lake upkeep, and her land and vacant-lot valuations rose sharply.
budget_items.quote: the land my house sits on went from $250,000 in 2021 to almost $600,000

budget_items.topic: Assessed value of a 480 sq ft home
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident said his 480 square foot house was assessed at almost $500,000 and he receives no town services.
An unnamed resident said his family's properties' taxes rose 137% and offered a figure for sale.
budget_items.quote: if anyone wants to buy our property for a $1.2 m, come talk to me.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Residents urged the board to reallocate or reduce Free Cash to address the tax increases; no dollar amount was set.
budget_items.quote: maybe not have so much money in free cash

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Residents cited a 135% land-value increase on lake properties and a 136% increase on one property's land, and asked for the criteria behind it.
